name: Vayland
description:
❤️Welcome to the game project VayLand⚡.

We took the best, discarded the unnecessary and made interesting. Always up to date version of the game!

We have few servers, so each of them is worked out very qualitatively. Don't believe us? Come in and check it out for yourself.

If there are problems, responsive Administration is always happy to help you, remember for this! Everyone enjoy the game✌.

Already developed such servers as:

⭐Vanilla - The server is absolutely clean from plugins, without privileges and any privates. Allowed gryferstvo and the destruction of houses. Develop and fight with other players, without any rules!

⭐Survival - Classic server with standard plugins. The server has PVP arena, Tavern, Auction, Titles, Mystic Boxes, Game Kits, Daily Rewards, Bank and regions. Griffing is forbidden here, you want to kill a player? Go fight him in the PVP arena!

⭐SkyBlock - Ready to survive on your own flying island? Then you're here! There are 9 islands for survival, each of them you can try out yourself, without any donations. There are Auctions, Shops, Boxes, Titles, Parkour, PVP arena, you can try it all on this wonderful server.
